column1: # Condition codes each instruction leaves, as M68000PRM (the "Condition Codes:" block of its page) gives them.
# Symbols: * set according to the result (N, Z) or to the operation (X, V, C); - unaffected; 0 cleared; 1 set;
# U undefined; ~ Z cleared if the result is nonzero, else unchanged (extended-precision forms).
# tests/ccr.rs runs each row under qemu: it is the second reader of the manual.
